Kaya: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we captured the missing-span cause and a short remediation list. want to assign owners and timelines so this doesn't keep recurring.
Riley: +1. can we split into infra vs instrumentation?
Priya: yep — infra: ETL lag + aggregator backfills. instrumentation: span sampling config + schema drift alerts.
Kaya: infra owner suggestion: @Jesse for ETL pipelines. instrumentation owner suggestion: @Marta for spans/sdks. ok?
Jesse: I can take ETL. earliest I can start deep-dive is tomorrow, but I'll post an initial runbook checklist today.
Marta: taking spans. will audit the sampling rules and the proto->json transforms. ETA: 3 business days for audit, then a small patch.
Kaya: thanks. action items I'm logging now: 1) ETL job concurrency audit — Jesse — 2024-10-02 2) Aggregator rollup reconciliation query — Jesse — 2024-10-05 3) Sampling rule audit — Marta — 2024-10-01 4) Add schema drift alert in observability — Priya — 2024-09-30
Priya: I'll add the alert (sigterms: schema_mismatch, aggregator_count_delta). putting alert as P2 but will surface to SRE for daytime paging if delta>5%.
Riley: can we also add a short playbook snippet: if missing spans > threshold, fallback to cached counts and flag downstream consumers?
Kaya: yes — new fallback plan: when spans coverage <80% for 15m, switch aggregator to tolerate partial keys and annotate consumers. owner: Priya. ETA: 2024-10-04.
Jesse: quick note: I found one flaky node in the ETL pool that causes intermittent lag under burst. I'll run the repro with `./etl/check_node_health.sh --since 8h` and post logs.
eng-oncall-bot: deploy scheduled: etl-worker-pool fix by Jesse planned for 2024-09-29 02:00 UTC — ETA 15m; will auto-rollback on >2% error increase.
Marta: instrumentation audit plan (short): 1) compare client SDK sampling defaults 2) verify header propagation for trace_id 3) backfill missing span IDs for last 7 days where possible. I'll paste a quick query: ```sql
-- find traces with missing spans
select trace_id, count(*) as events, sum(case when span_id is null then 1 else 0 end) as missing from events
where service = 'ingest' and ts > now() - interval '7 days'
group by trace_id
order by missing desc
limit 50;
```
Kaya: nice. add that SQL to the postmortem doc and tag as evidence. link to doc: https://redwood/docs/postmortems/2024-09-27-spans-aggregation (internal).
Priya: will add the doc link and create the alert in pagerduty->observability team.
Riley: suggested timeline check-ins: 3-day audit completion check, then weekly sync until all actions closed. can we set a rotating owner for the weekly check until closed?
Kaya: rotating owner worked before. I'll schedule a 30m sync every friday for 6 weeks. first sync 2024-10-04. rotation: Jesse, Marta, Priya, Riley, Kaya, Jesse (repeat).
Jesse: can you add me to the runbook PR? I'll include the exact query to reconcile aggregator counts: ```sql
-- reconcile: aggregator vs raw
select k, sum(raw_count) as raw, sum(agg_count) as agg, (sum(raw_count)-sum(agg_count)) as delta
from raw_events join aggregator using (k)
where ts between :start and :end
group by k
order by delta desc
limit 200;
```
Marta: also propose a small monitoring tweak: plot aggregator delta 95p over 1h and alert at >10k or >1% whichever smaller. owner: Marta to implement in dashboard. ETA: 2024-10-03.
Kaya: ownership summary: Jesse (ETL + reconciliation), Marta (spans + dashboard), Priya (alerts + fallback), Riley (process + check-ins). I'll update the postmortem checklist with owners and timelines.
Priya: one more recurring-pattern note — we've seen similar drift after deploys with schema bumps. propose adding a pre-deploy quick-check that runs the above reconcile query on a sample window. owner: Riley. ETA: 2024-10-06.
Riley: I can add a short CI job that runs reconcile on a 5m sample before prod deploys. low overhead.
Kaya: cool. next steps for everyone: post task in GH issues linking to this thread and tag milestone `obs-cleanup-q4`. I'll create the milestone and the first umbrella issue.
Jesse: posted GH issue for ETL tasks: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/4822 — linked to milestone.
Marta: PR for sampling config incoming — will request review from @Priya and @Riley.
Priya: added the alert and a PagerDuty escalation policy draft: https://pagerduty.local/ops/rotation/obs-drift — please review.
Kaya: thanks all. we'll close threads as actions finish. ping me on slack if blockers show up. :white_check_mark:
Riley: noted. leaving the 10/04 sync on calendar.
eng-oncall-bot: reminder: weekly obs-cleanup sync scheduled 2024-10-04 15:00 UTC — attendees: Jesse, Marta, Priya, Riley, Kaya
Marta: small question — for backfills, prefer snapshots or streaming? I vote snapshots for speed, streaming for low-latency reconciles. will propose hybrid plan in PR.
Jesse: agree. snapshots for >7d windows. streaming for near-real-time gaps.
Kaya: perfect. logging action items to the runbook now.
